newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: St George appoints Advance integration head.
newsitem.headline: St George appoints Advance integration head.

text.p: St George Bank said on Tuesday it has appointed its strategic operations and development general manager Mike Daly to head up integration with Advance Bank.
Daly will work with current integration head Neil Berkett until Berkett's departure in October, St George said.
The regional bank, the fifth largest in Australia, announced on July 1 that Berkett was leaving to pursue career opportunities in the United Kingdom.

St George managing director Jim Sweeney said Daly's experience in integrating Barclays Bank Australia into St George made him the best person to take over the integration of Advance, acquired late last year for A$2.6 billion.
